_comment: Velodyne VLP-16 (Puck) calibration shimmed into Ouster schema for COIN-LIO. 16 channels uniformly spaced 2 deg from +15 to -15 deg. Angles ordered TOP->BOTTOM (ring 0 = +15). 10 Hz with 0.2 deg horizontal resolution => 1800 columns per frame. VLP-16 has alternating laser firing (even/odd) which produces a small per-ring azimuth offset of about +/-1.4 deg; populated below in top->bottom order.
